subject: math
cluster: Draw and identify lines and angles, and classify shapes by properties of their lines and angles

items.prompt:
A line of symmetry splits a shape into
A) matching (mirror-image) halves
B) three parts
C) unequal parts
D) circles

How many lines of symmetry does a square have?
A) $2$
B) $4$
C) $1$
D) $0$

How many lines of symmetry does an equilateral triangle have?
A) $1$
B) $2$
C) $3$
D) $0$

A non-square rectangle has how many lines of symmetry?
A) $2$
B) $4$
C) $1$
D) $0$

How many lines of symmetry does a circle have?
A) $1$
B) $4$
C) infinitely many
D) $0$

A shape with no matching fold has how many lines of symmetry?
A) $0$
B) $1$
C) $2$
D) many

A regular hexagon has how many lines of symmetry?
A) $6$
B) $3$
C) $2$
D) $0$

Does a scalene triangle have a line of symmetry?
A) Yes, $1$
B) No, $0$
C) Yes, $3$
D) Yes, many
